shorts.hook: This cave was sealed for at least 2.5 million years.
shorts.title: This Cave Has Been Sealed for at Least 2.5 Million Years
shorts.outro: Down here lives something researchers call the king of the cave. Doug brought it a sandwich and took one deep breath. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHO IS THE KING OF THIS CAVE?
shorts.description: Movile Cave in Romania runs on chemicals instead of sunlight, and its air holds about a hundred times more carbon dioxide than ours; find out who rules it in the full episode.

shorts.hook: A scientist tasted water sealed in rock for a billion years.
shorts.title: A Scientist Tasted Billion-Year-Old Water
shorts.outro: Further down is the deepest mine on Earth, where a steel cage full of workers drops two kilometers in three minutes. Doug got in. It's linked below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT WAITS AT THE BOTTOM FOR DOUG?
shorts.description: Water sealed in rock for at least a billion years leaked out of a Canadian mine, and the geochemist who led the work tasted it (it is not drinking water); the full episode follows Doug into the cage of the deepest mine on Earth.

shorts.hook: The deepest hole ever drilled is twelve kilometers deep.
shorts.title: The Deepest Hole Ever Drilled Is 0.2% of the Way Down
shorts.outro: Doug did not fit down the hole. So the narrator lowered something of his on a string instead, and it came back warm. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT WENT DOWN INSTEAD OF DOUG?
shorts.description: The Kola Superdeep Borehole reached about 12 kilometers before the rock got too hot to drill, and that is barely a scratch on the planet; the full episode reveals what went down instead of Doug.
